plugins.name: ks-suite
plugins.description: Installs the KarmaSuite set in one go: ks (workflows, CLIs) and ks-flow (session board). ks-master and ks-browser are installed on their own and enabled per session by their launchers.

plugins.name: ks-flow
plugins.description: Per-project Kanban board over your Claude Code sessions, with macOS notifications when a session blocks waiting for you

plugins.name: ks-agent-limit
plugins.description: (disabled — not maintained) Caps how many Claude sessions and agents run at once on this machine; a spawn past the limit is refused and reported

plugins.name: ks-master
plugins.description: The ks-flow master session: reads Slack into the Briefing board on a schedule, runs log-in and log-off, and wakes itself on requests from the ks-flow daemon and board

plugins.name: ks-browser
plugins.description: Browser testing on demand: the agent-browser MCP server and a skill that records a test run as a short review video with title cards and chapters
